BudgetExhausted.description: The budget is exhausted for everything it applies to.

period_end.description: Exclusive end of the exhausted period as an RFC 3339 timestamp. With both boundaries set, the block applies throughout that interval even if the policy timezone changes. Without an end, the gateway matches the start against the current period in the policy timezone in standalone mode and UTC in managed mode.

period_start.description: Inclusive start of the exhausted period as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Omit both boundaries to block in every period.

reason.description: What a rejected request is told.

BudgetMemberExhausted.description: One member's share of a `team_member` budget is exhausted.

period_end.description: Exclusive end of the exhausted period as an RFC 3339 timestamp. With both boundaries set, the block applies throughout that interval even if the policy timezone changes. Without an end, the gateway matches the start against the current period in the policy timezone in standalone mode and UTC in managed mode.

period_start.description: Inclusive start of the member's exhausted period as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

reason.description: What a rejected request is told.

BudgetReason.description: The detail a request rejected by an exhausted budget is answered with. Amounts are decimal strings in the organization's currency.

code.description: Error code. The response always reports `budget_exceeded`.

message.description: Human-readable message returned to the caller.

message_prefix.description: Message text preceding the reset time. When present, the gateway appends the reset date, time, and policy timezone to this text and returns the result in place of `message`.

period_resets_at.description: Ignored: the gateway computes when the period resets.

remaining.description: Limit minus spend; zero or negative.

retry_after_seconds.description: Ignored: the gateway computes how long until the period resets.

scope_ref.description: Id of the capped resource, or the tag for scope `tag`.

spent.description: Spend in the period when the budget was exhausted.

type.description: Error type. The response always reports `billing_error`.

description:
A hard-stop spend cap that applies in this environment, and whether it is currently exhausted.

The document's id is the budget's id. Only hard-stop budgets are present: a budget that only warns never blocks a request, so it has no document.

exhausted.description: Set while the budget is exhausted for everything it applies to. For scope `team_member` it applies to every member of the team.

exhausted_members.description: Members of the team who have exhausted their own share of a `team_member` budget, keyed by member id. Read only for scope `team_member`.

period.description: Accounting period. Calendar boundaries follow `budget_policy.timezone` when configured, or UTC when omitted: a day starts at 00:00, a week on Monday at 00:00, and a month on the 1st at 00:00.

scope.description:
What the budget caps.

- `org`, `environment`: every API key in this environment. - `api_key`: the API key whose id is `scope_ref`. - `member`: every API key whose `user_id` is `scope_ref`. - `team`: every API key whose `team_id` is `scope_ref`. - `team_member`: every API key whose `team_id` is `scope_ref` and that also names a member; each member is capped separately. - `tag`: every request whose effective value for `tag.key` is `tag.value`. That value is what the identity provider's `tag_claims` reads from the token, else the API key's, else its team's, else its member's, so requests on one API key can differ. - `provider_key`: every upstream call made with the provider key whose id is `scope_ref`.

scope_ref.description: Id of the capped resource. Present for every scope except `tag`.

tag.description: The capped tag. Present only for scope `tag`.
